'''Thermodraft''', as it was called by [[Ozurist]], was a stationary machine that was part of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] infrastructure. Located in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]], Thermodraft was attacked during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by a group of "[[mobile]]s", rogue [[Droid/Legends|droids]] whose programming was corrupted in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. These droids were attempting to exterminate biological life on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] so that they could rule it for themselves.

Ozurist asked a traveling hero to travel into the Works and save Thermodraft, as its destruction would result in a massive explosion and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] leak that would kill billions. The hero was able to release the pressure values on Thermodraft's exoskeleton, releasing the pressure and averting the disaster.

==Behind the scenes==
Thermodraft appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The Republic character is asked by Ozurist to fix Thermodraft as part of the mission "Meltdown!" on Coruscant.
